gapReview.meaning: Source asserts mean-oracle risk without displaying the mean/variance expansion or feasibility of the mean.
No explicit causal-information independence or expected cross-term argument is printed. The no-better assertion needs admissibility, not bounded predictions alone.
Division identity and asymptotic equivalence are asserted without proof. Inventoried for complete page coverage but outside the four targets.
Supplied source contains no sigma-field completion, modulo-ae measurable set definition, or real-valued version theorem. This is added general measure theory, not an omitted author theorem.
Private seed, generated information sigma field, measurable factorization, null-set modification and common event are explicit formal-model extensions absent from the source.
The supplied pages do not characterize a minimum/sInf of expected fixed losses. Its equality to T variance requires a derived proof from the source mean benchmark, with minimum outside expectation.

targetRootClosure.T1: M-DEFINITION -> countable Borel preimage representatives -> coherent measurable real reconstruction. No direct printed theorem root.
targetRootClosure.T2: T1 + information inclusion/comap factorization + measurable clamp + common countable AE event. hpb is used only for preserving original values after clamp.
targetRootClosure.T3: T1 AND [unbounded joint-history measurable-image route OR information-field route] AND AE independence transport. No bounded T2 is required.
targetRootClosure.T4: [T3 plus integrable centered-risk expansion OR T2 plus policy risk expansion and AE transfer] AND expected fixed-scalar minimum/finite sums/nonnegativity/zero horizon. The p3 empirical minimizer is not a dependency.

independentAdversarialChecks: If P_t=Y_t for nondegenerate Bernoulli IID observations, prediction loss is zero and source variance baseline is positive. Thus unit feasibility alone cannot give nonnegative excess; strict information restriction is essential.

A seed equal to XOR of two independent Bernoulli coordinates is independent of each coordinate separately but with Y_0 reveals Y_1. Whole-stream seed independence cannot be weakened to pairwise coordinate independence.

For trivial F and nonatomic ambient measure, an ambient-null singleton is in eventuallyMeasurableSpace F (ae mu) although not in the usual completion of the restricted trivial sigma-algebra. Therefore the named construction must be defined literally.
